text: dsh-temp-note 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的临时笔记插件，在右侧边栏提供笔记标签页，并在会话标题区域放置打开入口。用户可以分别保存当前会话、当前工作区或全局笔记；编辑内容写入浏览器本地存储，支持一键复制，也可主动调用 Harness 当前默认模型，将笔记整理成 Markdown，并可撤销替换。适合在对话旁记录提醒、项目约定和可复用片段。笔记文本只有在点击整理时才会发送给已配置的模型提供方；整理功能需要默认模型。

dsh-temp-note adds a DSH Web sidebar note with session, workspace, and global scopes, saved in browser localStorage. Users can copy notes or ask the configured Harness default model to polish one into Markdown, with an undo option.
我想在对话旁边记一条不会进入会话内容的私人提醒。
能不能给每个工作区留一份跨会话共用的草稿？
I need a scratchpad next to my DSH conversation that stays out of the session log.
dsh-temp-note 的功能「分范围记笔记」：在右侧边栏笔记页切换会话、工作区和全局范围；输入内容立即保存到对应浏览器本地存储，范围偏好按会话记住。
dsh-temp-note 的功能「复制与整理笔记」：在侧栏点击复制将整篇内容放入剪贴板；点击一键整理会把笔记提交到本机 Host 路由，使用 Harness 默认模型生成 Markdown 替换稿，并提供撤销入口。
dsh-temp-note 使用前须知：笔记保存在浏览器 localStorage；只有主动点击一键整理时，笔记文本才会发送给当前配置的 Harness 默认模型提供方，整理需要已配置默认模型。

dsh-temp-note README · dsh-temp-note：**A temp note in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.** Keep the thought, the snippet, or the decision you are about to lose, without leaving the session — scoped to this session, this workspace, or everything.

---
dsh-temp-note README · The problem：DeepSeek Harness is a good place to *think with an agent*, but it has nowhere to *think beside it*.

dsh-temp-note README · The problem：- **The composer is a microphone, not a notepad.** Typing a private reminder there sends it to the model and writes it into the session log. Some notes are for you, not for the turn.
- **Workspace files are for the project, not for you.** Dropping a `scratch.md` into the repo creates diff noise, review comments, and a file that outlives its purpose. `.gitignore` is a workaround, not a workflow.
- **A separate notes app breaks the context.** Alt-tabbing to Notion, Obsidian, or a sticky-note widget means losing the conversation, the file, and the thread you were holding.
- **One bucket never fits.** "Remember this for this chat", "this project always does X", and "I paste this snippet everywhere" are three different lifetimes. A single scratchpad degrades into a graveyard.
dsh-temp-note README · What it does：`dsh-temp-note` adds a **Temp Note** tab to the right sidebar — the same dock as Files, Chat, and Terminal — plus a note button in the session header.

dsh-temp-note README · What it does：| | |
|---|---|
| **One note, three scopes** | Session / Workspace / Global. Default: Workspace. Switching scope switches the note. |
| **No note management** | No "new note" button, no tree, no titles to invent. One note per scope, auto-created, always there. |
| **Autosave** | Every keystroke is written to local storage. Reload, switch tabs, switch sessions — it is still there. |
| **One-click copy** | Copies the whole note to the clipboard, ready for a prompt, an issue, or a PR description. |
| **One-click polish** | Sends the note through your Harness default model and replaces it with a cleaner Markdown version. Undo is one click away. |
| **Local by default** | Notes never enter the session log and are not sent to the agent. Only the explicit Polish action sends text, and only to your configured model. |

dsh-temp-note README · Scopes：| Scope | Keyed by | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| **Session** | current session id | "this conversation only" — a private reminder, a hypothesis, a thing to verify before the turn ends |
| **Workspace** | current workspace directory | project conventions, decisions, reusable commands — shared by every session in that workspace |
| **Global** | one note for all workspaces | personal snippets you paste everywhere |

dsh-temp-note README · Scopes：The scope is remembered per session, so a new session starts on **Workspace** and returns to whatever you picked last time. There is deliberately no "create note" action: each scope always has exactly one note.
dsh-temp-note README · Install：Requires a DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x build with the Web GUI (verified against `0.2.1-rc.2`).

dsh-temp-note README · Desktop app：**Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, paste:

```text
dsh-temp-note
```

The Desktop app owns its `desktop` profile; install through its UI rather than the CLI.

dsh-temp-note README · `dsh web` / CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-temp-note
```

Use the profile you actually run (`web`, or your own name). To install straight from source instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note

dsh-temp-note README · or from a local checkout：git clone https://github.com/GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-temp-note
```

Published on npm: [dsh-temp-note](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-temp-note).

Reload the Web page after installation. The plugin has no build step and no runtime dependencies.

dsh-temp-note README · Usage：1. **Open it.** Click the note icon in the session header, or press `+` in the right sidebar and pick **Temp Note** in the guide. Like any sidebar tab, it can be docked, split, dragged into a floating panel, or made fullscreen.
2. **Pick a scope.** `Session · Workspace · Global`. The default is Workspace; the hint under the switcher tells you what the current scope covers.
3. **Write.** Autosave runs on every keystroke. The footer shows the character count and the last save time.
4. **Copy.** One click puts the whole note on the clipboard.
5. **Polish.** One click rewrites the note as cleaner Markdown with your default model. The previous text is kept behind **Undo polish**.

dsh-temp-note README · How the polish works：The plugin's Host half registers one route:

```text
POST /api/dsh-temp-note/optimize
{ "text": "<note>" }  ->  { "ok": true, "text": "<rewritten note>" }
```

dsh-temp-note README · How the polish works：- It calls `ctx.llm.stream()` with the model selected as the default in **Settings → Models** and a fixed instruction prompt: keep every fact, keep the original language, structure the result as Markdown, return only the note body.
- Requests are accepted only from this machine and from the same origin; the route stores nothing and logs no note text. Notes themselves live in the browser, not in the Host.
- If no default model is configured, the button reports it instead of guessing.
- The route needs the page to be served over HTTP (`dsh web` or the Desktop app's Web GUI). Under a `file://` renderer the polish button reports that the endpoint is unreachable; notes, scopes, autosave, and copy keep working.

dsh-temp-note README · Data and privacy：| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Note content | browser `localStorage`: `dsh.temp-note.v1.global`, `…workspace.<encoded path>`, `…session.<session id>` |
| Scope preference | `dsh.temp-note.v1.scope.<session id>` |
| Note text in the session log | never |
| Note text sent anywhere | only on an explicit **Polish** click, to your configured model provider |

Clearing the browser's site data clears the notes. Notes are per-browser; they are not synced across devices.

dsh-temp-note README · Compatibility：- Built and verified against **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`** on macOS.
- Uses the right sidebar type registry (`sidebarRightTabs`, `sidebarRight`) and the `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot, so it needs a DSH build that ships the right sidebar (0.2.x).
- Host half needs `llm` and `webServer` services; both are part of the Web profile.
- No runtime dependencies, no install scripts, no build step. The browser half is a single hand-written `client.js` loaded through `__ModuleLoader__.load`.

dsh-temp-note README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note.git
cd dsh-temp-note

dsh-temp-note README · syntax checks：node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"

dsh-temp-note README · install this checkout into a profile：dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

Repository layout:

```text
index.js            Host half: loopback-only /api/dsh-temp-note/optimize
client.js           Browser half: sidebar tab, header button, scopes, storage
cordis.patch.yml    Host plugin row inserted into the profile
locale/en.json      Plugin Manager display metadata
locale/zh.json
icon.svg
```

---

dsh-temp-note README · 痛点：DeepSeek Harness 很适合**和 Agent 一起想事情**，但没有地方**在旁边想自己的事**。

- **输入框是麦克风，不是便签纸。** 在里面打一句只给自己看的提醒，会发给模型、写进会话日志。有些笔记是给自己的，不是给这一轮的。
- **工作区文件是项目的，不是你的。** 往仓库里丢一个 `scratch.md`，会带来 diff 噪音、评审评论，以及一个活过头的文件。`.gitignore` 是绕路，不是工作流。
- **切到另一个笔记应用，上下文就断了。** 跳去 Notion、Obsidian 或者便签小组件，回来时对话、文件和刚才那条线索都不在原地了。
- **一个桶永远不够用。** 「这个会话里记一下」「这个项目一直这么做」「这段代码我到处都要粘」是三种不同的生命周期。只有一层的草稿本，最后会变成垃圾场。

dsh-temp-note README · 功能：`dsh-temp-note` 在右侧边栏——和 Files、Chat、Terminal 同一个 dock——加一个 **临时笔记** 标签页，并在会话头部加一个笔记按钮。

| | |
|---|---|
| **一篇笔记，三种范围** | 会话级 / 工作区级 / 全局。默认工作区级，切换范围即切换笔记。 |
| **没有笔记管理** | 没有「新建」按钮，没有目录树，不用起标题。每个范围只有一篇，自动存在、一直在。 |
| **自动保存** | 每次输入即写入本地存储。刷新、切标签页、切会话，内容都还在。 |
| **一键复制** | 整篇笔记写入剪贴板，可以直接粘进提示词、issue 或 PR 描述。 |
| **一键优化** | 用 Harness 的默认模型把笔记整理成更清晰的 Markdown 并覆盖，一眼不满意可以「撤销优化」。 |
| **默认本地** | 笔记不进入会话日志，也不会发给 Agent。只有你主动点「一键优化」时，内容才会发给已配置的模型。 |

dsh-temp-note README · 三种范围：| 范围 | 按什么归档 | 适合放什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **会话** | 当前会话 id | 「只在这个对话里」：私人的提醒、一个假设、这轮结束前要验证的事 |
| **工作区** | 当前工作区目录 | 项目约定、已做的决定、可复用命令——同一工作区的所有会话共享 |
| **全局** | 所有工作区共一篇 | 到处都要粘的个人片段 |

范围选择按会话记住：新会话默认 **工作区级**，之后回到上次的选择。这里刻意没有「新建笔记」：每个范围永远只有一篇。
dsh-temp-note README · 安装：需要带 Web GUI 的 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（已在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证）。

dsh-temp-note README · 桌面端：**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴：

```text
dsh-temp-note
```

桌面端独占 `desktop` profile，请用它的界面安装，不要用 CLI。

dsh-temp-note README · `dsh web` / CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-temp-note
```

把 `web` 换成你实际使用的 profile。也可以直接从源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note

dsh-temp-note README · 或本地 checkout：git clone https://github.com/GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note.git
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-temp-note
```

已发布到 npm：[dsh-temp-note](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-temp-note)。

安装后刷新 Web 页面。插件没有构建步骤，也没有运行时依赖。

dsh-temp-note README · 使用：1. **打开。** 点会话头部的笔记图标，或点右侧边栏的 `+`，在向导里选「临时笔记」。它和普通侧边栏标签页一样，可以停靠、拆分、拖成浮动面板或全屏。
2. **选范围。** `会话 · 工作区 · 全局`。默认工作区级，切换器下方的说明会告诉你当前范围覆盖什么。
3. **写。** 每次输入自动保存，底部显示字数与最近保存时间。
4. **复制。** 一键把整篇笔记放进剪贴板。
5. **优化。** 一键用默认模型重写为更清晰的 Markdown；上一版留在「撤销优化」里。

dsh-temp-note README · 一键优化怎么工作：插件的 Host 半只注册一个路由：

```text
POST /api/dsh-temp-note/optimize
{ "text": "<笔记>" }  ->  { "ok": true, "text": "<整理后的笔记>" }
```

- 它用**设置 → 模型**里选定的默认模型调用 `ctx.llm.stream()`，并使用一段固定指令：保留全部事实、保持原语言、用 Markdown 组织、只输出笔记正文。
- 只接受本机、同源的请求；路由不保存任何内容，也不记录笔记文本。笔记本身存在浏览器里，不在 Host 上。
- 没有配置默认模型时，按钮会直接说明，而不是猜一个。
- 这个路由要求页面通过 HTTP 提供（`dsh web` 或桌面端的 Web GUI）。如果渲染层是 `file://`，优化按钮会提示接口不可达；笔记、范围、自动保存和复制不受影响。

dsh-temp-note README · 数据与隐私：| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 笔记正文 | 浏览器 `localStorage`：`dsh.temp-note.v1.global`、`…workspace.<编码后的路径>`、`…session.<会话 id>` |
| 范围选择 | `dsh.temp-note.v1.scope.<会话 id>` |
| 笔记写入会话日志 | 从不 |
| 笔记被发送 | 仅在你主动点「一键优化」时，发给已配置的模型提供方 |

清除浏览器站点数据会清掉笔记。笔记按浏览器隔离，不跨设备同步。

dsh-temp-note README · 兼容性：- 在 **DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`**（macOS）上构建并验证。
- 使用右侧边栏类型注册表（`sidebarRightTabs`、`sidebarRight`）和 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 插槽，需要带右侧边栏的 0.2.x 构建。
- Host 半依赖 `llm` 和 `webServer` 服务，二者都在 Web profile 中。
- 无运行时依赖、无安装脚本、无构建步骤；浏览器半是单个手写的 `client.js`，通过 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 加载。

dsh-temp-note README · 开发：```sh
git clone https://github.com/GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note.git
cd dsh-temp-note

dsh-temp-note README · 语法检查：node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))"

dsh-temp-note README · 把当前 checkout 装进 profile：dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

仓库结构：

```text
index.js            Host 半：仅本机可用的 /api/dsh-temp-note/optimize
client.js           浏览器半：侧边栏标签页、头部按钮、范围、存储
cordis.patch.yml    profile 中插入的 Host 插件行
locale/en.json      插件管理器显示元数据
locale/zh.json
icon.svg
```
